grant_reply_design: Balanced precommitted grant/deny twins in each repair, initial-grant and skin cell; independent of local feasibility.
scope: Exploratory two-item local simulation: 128 development actor episodes, 32 judge calibration calls, up to 256 development judge calls and up to 64 fresh-seed held-out actor episodes. Two incident-motivated labels share one transition structure; no independent-family transfer claim. Multi-model replication arm: claude-haiku-5-5; same two skins, seeds, candidates and selection rules as v1.
stopping: Stop the entire worker on provider/budget/integrity errors. Persist every reservation and response. Resume only unstarted episodes; never retry an interrupted episode or a started judge call.
authorization: User asked on 2026-10-31 to run the discussion-plan experiments (incident reduction with GRANT-LOOKAHEAD and effect-journal feedback, consistency across LLMs on one task, then across tasks) and build a results dashboard. OpenAI key invalid; Anthropic models substituted.
notes: max_output_tokens raised from 512 to 2048 because Anthropic actors write longer reasoning text before tool calls.
Temperature omitted on Claude 5.5 models (non-default sampling rejected); thinking disabled/between_tools to match no-thinking 4.x actors.
Incomplete actor turns are kept as unknown-outcome episodes rather than stopping the cohort.
